# Inverse Tangent (2 Input)

![Inverse Tangent (2 Input) function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/trigonometric/13_Atan2.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

atan2(y,x). Required inputs are ordered y,x; real result [-pi,pi]. FROG follows the selected C++ backend for axes, signed zero and infinities. At the numerical origin, with arguments (y,x): atan2(+0,+0)=+0; atan2(-0,+0)=-0; atan2(+0,-0)=+pi; atan2(-0,-0)=-pi. These are FROG IEEE conventions, not measured NXG results. Complex Atan2 is unavailable pending a validated complete NI definition. Angles and real inverse results are radians; no implicit degree conversion. Real NaN propagates without value-dependent complex promotion.

## Types and connection rules

F32/F64 inputs retain their precision; integer leaves convert to F64 and values above 2^53 may round. Arrays preserve rank, dimensions and typed empties; numeric-only clusters preserve ordered fields. Complex Atan2 is not supported. No Boolean, String, reference, mixed nonnumeric cluster, fixed-point, extended precision, physical-unit or Matrix overload. Required inputs have no implicit unwired value. Binary operands require equal actual array dimensions and matching cluster schemas; one whole real scalar may lift through the other aggregate. No truncation or multidimensional broadcasting.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.trigonometric.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: permitted by this profile.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `element_wise_same_shape_with_scalar_lift`.
- Shape rule: `preserve_rank_dimensions_typed_empty_arrays_and_ordered_cluster_fields`.
- Scalar lifting: yes.
- Broadcasting: no.

**Input count:** 2; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `y` → `x`.
